title: Out-teened.
subject: PNN: Adults cannot outwit teens at pranks. A study, with statistics, and one very short pirate raid.
preheader: A crew of grown pirates met one teenager with a foam blaster. Statistics included.

featuredCase.teaser: **One teen. A whole crew of grown pirates. One foam dart at their feet.** The Crimson Crew tried to prank the pink house and was caught by the lights, a camera, and a junior panther. The grown-ups begged. Clueso has the file. *Whether the candy survived is a matter for the taste panel.*
featuredCase.hook: including a pirate lineup where every suspect volunteered

image.alt: PNN pencil-sketch suspect composite for case PNN-010: a teenager in a pink cat-ear hoodie stands in a garage doorway aiming a foam dart blaster at the ground while three pirates in red bandanas kneel on the driveway, begging. One hugs a sack labeled Candy (Vintage), one holds a box labeled Stolen Booty, and one waves a white flag. A rubber chicken and a foam sword lie nearby. Margin notes read: Warning shot: foam. Nobody hurt. Egos: critically wounded. Begged. Promised candy. (Old candy.)

sections.heading: The numbers, such as they are

items.text: **Pirates to teen in the PNN sketch.** The household says *'several.'* The teen says *'enough.'*
**Foam darts fired.** *Nobody asked for a second.*
**Adults who begged.** The teen's begging rate: *0%.*
**Age of the Crew's candy, give or take a Halloween.** *Best-by date: 'previous administration.'*
**Known uses for last year's Halloween candy:** bribery, ballast, and *a lesson.* Bribery succeeded *0%* of the time. The lesson, *100%.*
**Dose of vitamin C recommended for a crew that eats this candy.** *Scurvy risk: high. The Crew is advised to eat a fruit and to stop eating the candy.*
